name: Senior Loan Officer Survey (C&I standards)
consensus_source: No published consensus found for the SLOOS C&I net tightening figure
read: Net 1.7% of banks tightened C&I standards, up from 0.0% prior (+1.7pt). Standards are roughly neutral, a small turn toward tightening. No consensus. Leads activity by 6 to 18 months; not yet a restrictive signal.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
